library.pt_080:r_4eaaa79892e5d399.text:
Agent from the L5 colony cluster who came down to Earth as part of $$オペレーション・メテオ$$. 16 years old.
Direct descendant of a warrior clan tracing its origins to ancient China, he was raised as a warrior under the creed that "strength alone is justice."
He regards OZ's practice of trampling the weak through force as evil, and fights in the belief that it is justice to strike them down with even greater force.
Because of this, when he was defeated by $$トレーズ$$ in unarmed combat, he was forced to confront his own weakness and lost his will to fight. In the midst of this, seeing $$サリィ・ポォ$$ admit her own weakness and still choose to keep fighting, he came to believe that the resolve to keep fighting is what moves the world, and regained his will to fight.
However, though he wins his rematch against $$トレーズ$$ in the final battle, the outcome ends in a puzzling way that could be seen as a hollow victory.
After the war, he joins the $$マリーメイア$$ Army for reasons of his own.

library.pt_080:r_37bb9575f68521df.text:

However, though he wins his rematch against $$トレーズ$$ in the final battle, the outcome ends in a puzzling way that could be seen as a hollow victory.
After the war, seeing a world where citizens had forgotten how to fight now that peace had come, while soldiers who had lost their place still remained, he began to question whether justice truly existed in it. As his answer, he deliberately chose to become evil and joined the $$マリーメイア$$ Army.
In the course of the fighting, through dialogue with $$ヒイロ$$ and by witnessing the citizens who rose up to challenge the $$マリーメイア$$ Army, he settled his own doubts and brought his fight to an end.

library.pt_080:r_87cc3d7f1d05c874.text:
A pilot belonging to the Preventers. Codename Wind. 20 years old.
His real name is Milliardo Peacecraft. He is the prince of the Sank Kingdom, a nation that once advocated total pacifism and was destroyed by the Earth $$スフィア$$ Unified Alliance.
In the previous war, he declared war on Earth as the leader of $$ホワイトファング$$.
Like $$リリーナ$$, he was a man who carried on his father's will and wished for peace, but when the Sank Kingdom that $$リリーナ$$ had restored collapsed, he came to believe that humanity needed to be shown the folly of starting a war for the sake of achieving total peace, and he attempted to carry out the "Libra Drop."
In the final battle, the plan was stopped by the Gundam pilots' efforts, and he himself was defeated after a one-on-one duel with $$ヒイロ$$. He went missing after being caught in the explosion when Libra's power unit was destroyed, but to counter the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's rebellion, he returned to the battlefield piloting the $$トールギスⅢ$$ under the name "$$プリベンター$$ Wind."
Because of his past as an OZ pilot who fought for revenge for his homeland, he believes his own hands are stained, and he intends to devote his strength to supporting $$リリーナ$$ from behind the scenes for the sake of true peace.

After the $$マリーメイア$$ rebellion came to an end, he set off together with $$ノイン$$ to carry out $$リリーナ$$'s terraforming plan.

library.pt_080:r_bf8f7b744563fa5d.text:
A member of the Preventers. Codename Fire.
She was formerly a training instructor for OZ's new recruits.
She graduated the military academy in second place, behind only $$ゼクス$$, and excels both as a commanding officer and as a mobile suit pilot.
Since her academy days she has loved $$ゼクス$$ deeply, so much so that she kept an exact count of the time they spent apart.
When she lost the new recruits she had trained to $$五飛$$'s attack, she swore revenge and became $$ゼクス$$'s subordinate, but when $$ゼクス$$ defected from OZ she followed him and defected as well, going on to serve as bodyguard to his sister $$リリーナ$$.
When $$リリーナ$$ founded the new Sank Kingdom, $$ノイン$$ served as her aide, handling practical matters such as secretly building up its armed forces.
After the war, she joined the Preventers and works to maintain the peace.

library.pt_080:r_0a9804cc666f2f7b.text:
A member of the Preventers. Codename Fire.
She was formerly a training instructor for OZ's new recruits.
She graduated the military academy in second place, behind only $$ゼクス$$, and excels both as a commanding officer and as a mobile suit pilot.
Since her academy days she has loved $$ゼクス$$ deeply, so much so that she kept an exact count of the time they spent apart.
When she lost the new recruits she had trained to $$五飛$$'s attack, she swore revenge and became $$ゼクス$$'s subordinate, but when $$ゼクス$$ defected from OZ she followed him and defected as well, going on to serve as bodyguard to his sister $$リリーナ$$.
When $$リリーナ$$ founded the new Sank Kingdom, $$ノイン$$ served as her aide, handling practical matters such as secretly building up its armed forces.
After the war, she joined the Preventers and worked to maintain the peace, and in the battle against the $$マリーメイア$$ Army in Brussels she piloted a $$トーラス$$, putting on a showing no less impressive than the Gundam pilots'.
After the $$マリーメイア$$ rebellion, she was reunited with $$ゼクス$$, and the two of them set off into space together to take part in the terraforming plan.

library.pt_080:r_566acff2ff34040e.text:
Vice Foreign Minister of the Earth $$スフィア$$ Unified Nation. 16 years old.
She is also the princess of the former Sank Kingdom, which once advocated total pacifism, and her real name is $$リリーナ$$ Peacecraft.
She was raised as the daughter of Vice Foreign Minister Darlian, but after her father's assassination she learned of her true origins and took up her birth father's will to advocate total pacifism, restoring the Sank Kingdom.
Though the nation collapsed under OZ's invasion, she was installed as the world's head of state through the machinations of the Romefeller Foundation. Buffeted by political scheming, she nonetheless continued to consistently appeal to the world for unarmed, nonviolent total pacifism.
With $$トレーズ$$'s rise to power she stepped down as head of state, but her unwavering stance in pursuit of peace earned her the support of many, and she continues to wield immense influence even after the war's end.
Now that the world has moved toward disarmament and her father's ideal has been achieved, she serves as Vice Foreign Minister, working to complete the work of her adoptive father Darlian by bridging the colonies and Earth.

library.pt_080:r_a7125bf574e82ba8.text:
Vice Foreign Minister of the Earth $$スフィア$$ Unified Nation. 16 years old.
She is also the princess of the former Sank Kingdom, which once advocated total pacifism, and her real name is $$リリーナ$$ Peacecraft.
She was raised as the daughter of Vice Foreign Minister Darlian, but after her father's assassination she learned of her true origins and took up her birth father's will to advocate total pacifism, restoring the Sank Kingdom.

With $$トレーズ$$'s rise to power she stepped down as head of state, but her unwavering stance in pursuit of peace earned her the support of many, and she continues to wield immense influence even after the war's end.
Now that the world has moved toward disarmament and her father's ideal has been achieved, she serves as Vice Foreign Minister, working to complete the work of her adoptive father Darlian by bridging the colonies and Earth.
Because of the scale of her influence, she was abducted by the $$マリーメイア$$ Army, but she faced $$マリーメイア$$ without fear and continued trying to persuade her.

library.pt_080:r_c7d16d0dc93c780b.text:
The young girl who symbolizes the $$マリーメイア$$ Army. 7 years old.
She is the daughter born of $$トレーズ$$ and Leia Barton, and $$デキム・バートン$$ is her grandfather.
She is proud to be $$トレーズ$$'s daughter and possesses intelligence beyond what one would expect of a 7-year-old girl. However, having been raised as $$デキム$$'s puppet, she has also been indoctrinated with his twisted ideas, and she behaves with arrogance toward others.

library.pt_080:r_fd09674b310ee4ef.text:
The young girl who symbolizes the $$マリーメイア$$ Army. 7 years old.
She is the daughter born of $$トレーズ$$ and Leia Barton, and $$デキム・バートン$$ is her grandfather.
She is proud to be $$トレーズ$$'s daughter and possesses intelligence beyond what one would expect of a 7-year-old girl. However, having been raised as $$デキム$$'s puppet, she has also been indoctrinated with his twisted ideas, and she behaves with arrogance toward others.
In the course of the fighting, moved by $$リリーナ$$'s persuasion and the Gundam pilots' actions, she realized her own mistake, and threw herself in front of $$リリーナ$$ to shield her from $$デキム$$'s bullet.
With the symbolic figurehead $$マリーメイア$$ losing her will to fight, and with the death of $$デキム$$, the army's true leader, the conflict came to an end.

library.pt_080:r_77b55be7b810a172.text:
Head of the Barton Foundation and $$マリーメイア$$'s grandfather.
While active as head of the foundation, he was secretly the man behind the scenes, providing support to insurgents such as Cairns and advancing $$オペレーション・メテオ$$. A man consumed by lust for power, he organized former $$ホワイトファング$$ soldiers and remnants of the $$トレーズ$$ faction into the $$マリーメイア$$ Army with $$マリーメイア$$ as its symbol.
He plots to seize control of the disarmed Earth $$スフィア$$ using mobile suit forces and dominate it.

library.pt_080:r_8c87edbc7d920d03.text:
Head of the Barton Foundation and $$マリーメイア$$'s grandfather.
While active as head of the foundation, he was secretly the man behind the scenes, providing support to insurgents such as Cairns and advancing $$オペレーション・メテオ$$. A man consumed by lust for power, he organized former $$ホワイトファング$$ soldiers and remnants of the $$トレーズ$$ faction into the $$マリーメイア$$ Army with $$マリーメイア$$ as its symbol.
He plots to seize control of the disarmed Earth $$スフィア$$ using mobile suit forces and dominate it.
However, thanks to the efforts of the Gundam pilots and the Preventers under $$ゼクス$$, along with an uprising of citizens who longed for peace, the rebellion failed. Consumed by his obsession, $$デキム$$ was prepared to abandon even $$マリーメイア$$ to achieve his ambition, but he was shot dead as a traitor by a young officer who had formerly served under $$トレーズ$$.

library.pt_080:r_9a7a6796ef8e2728.text:
Granddaughter of Duke Dermail, representative of the Romefeller Foundation.
She longs for war and holds her own aesthetic philosophy regarding it.
She is a distant relative of $$トレーズ$$'s (a cousin once removed) and shares a striking resemblance to him in the shape of her eyebrows.
She accompanies $$リリーナ$$ and openly voices her admiration for $$リリーナ$$'s unwavering commitment to total pacifism.
Though indirectly responsible for driving her own grandfather Dermail to his death, she boards Libra alone and joins $$ホワイトファング$$, using the Zero System to command a Mobile Doll unit and standing in the way of $$ヒイロ$$ and the others.
However, behind her war-loving personality lay a deep hatred of the war that had taken her father from her. In the final battle she confesses her true feelings, revealing that she sought to show the world a devastating war in order to put an end to war itself.
After the decisive battle, she meets $$ノイン$$ while visiting $$トレーズ$$'s grave and tells her she has grown tired of dwelling on the past, showing a determination to look toward the future.

During the $$マリーメイア$$ rebellion, she incited citizens who were already simmering with unrest, transporting them to the Presidential residence along with several vehicles.
Her personal car, incidentally, was still painted the same gold as before.

library.pt_080:r_bee73f3f5b449f0c.text:
A former OZ volunteer soldier from a space colony. Her rank at the time was Special Officer.
After her colony accepted OZ, she volunteered as a soldier out of a single-minded wish to protect her home. However, meeting $$デュオ$$ led her to question OZ's methods, and she ultimately broke away from them.
Since then, she has supported $$デュオ$$ both in war and in running their junk shop.
Even after the war's end, she continues to run the junk shop together with $$デュオ$$, unchanged.

library.pt_080:r_c26f97c0f5b3253c.text:
Leader of the Preventers. Codename Gold.
A woman of dignity and gentleness alike, skilled in all manner of strategy from military affairs to politics.
Before the war, she served as aide to OZ's supreme commander $$トレーズ$$. Devoted to $$トレーズ$$, she was a woman who would stop at nothing and accept no compromise in fulfilling his ideals. Her thoroughness was such that, in her effort to understand $$トレーズ$$'s thinking, she gave rise to a second personality resembling a saint.
Her two personalities remained unstable until she came to understand $$トレーズ$$'s true intentions, at which point they stabilized and merged into the single personality she has today.

library.pt_080:r_fc556d148e559489.text:
Leader of the Preventers. Codename Gold.
A woman of dignity and gentleness alike, skilled in all manner of strategy from military affairs to politics.
Before the war, she served as aide to OZ's supreme commander $$トレーズ$$. Devoted to $$トレーズ$$, she was a woman who would stop at nothing and accept no compromise in fulfilling his ideals. Her thoroughness was such that, in her effort to understand $$トレーズ$$'s thinking, she gave rise to a second personality resembling a saint.
Her two personalities remained unstable until she came to understand $$トレーズ$$'s true intentions, at which point they stabilized and merged into the single personality she has today.
During the $$マリーメイア$$ rebellion, she headed to the Presidential residence to save $$マリーメイア$$, the child $$トレーズ$$ left behind.

library.pt_080:r_30554622a06d59c5.text:
A member of the Preventers. Codename Water.
She previously served as a military doctor with the Alliance forces. Through her encounters with $$ヒイロ$$ and the others, she grew interested in the Gundam pilots, and after OZ's domination of the Earth $$スフィア$$ she became a member of the resistance, supporting them from then on.
A warm and embracing woman, she serves as a kind of buffer between the Preventers and the Gundam pilots.
Her kindness once helped heal the wounded heart of $$五飛$$, who had lost his will to fight after his defeat at $$トレーズ$$'s hands, while she was taking part with a guerrilla unit in his old home region of former China, and helped him find the will to rise again.
She also has an active side, and during the war she supported and directed various sabotage operations as part of an anti-OZ resistance faction, recovering the Heavyarms and Sandrock and delivering them to their pilots.

library.pt_080:r_644771e67a90c541.text:
A member of the Preventers. Codename Water.
She previously served as a military doctor with the Alliance forces. Through her encounters with $$ヒイロ$$ and the others, she grew interested in the Gundam pilots, and after OZ's domination of the Earth $$スフィア$$ she became a member of the resistance, supporting them from then on.
A warm and embracing woman, she serves as a kind of buffer between the Preventers and the Gundam pilots.
Her kindness once helped heal the wounded heart of $$五飛$$, who had lost his will to fight after his defeat at $$トレーズ$$'s hands, while she was taking part with a guerrilla unit in his old home region of former China, and helped him find the will to rise again.
She also has an active side, and during the war she supported and directed various sabotage operations as part of an anti-OZ resistance faction, recovering the Heavyarms and Sandrock and delivering them to their pilots.
After the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's rebellion came to an end, she recruited $$五飛$$ into the Preventers, and the two continue their activities together.

library.pt_080:r_a4bad97325a13c41.text:
A mobile suit pilot belonging to $$ザフト$$'s Minerva. 16 years old.
Born and raised in Orb, he lived peacefully with his family, untouched by war. But during the $$地球連合$$'s invasion of Orb in the previous war, he lost his parents and younger sister all at once before his eyes. Soon after, on the recommendation of Orb officer Todaka, he relocated to $$プラント$$, and believing that "protecting what matters requires strength," he enlisted in $$ザフト$$. He graduated the academy with outstanding grades, rising to wear the red coat that marks an elite pilot. Perhaps because of this history, though cheerful, he has a deeply naive side, and his aggression sometimes comes strongly to the surface.
$$デュランダル$$, hoping to draw out his hidden potential, selects him as the pilot of the state-of-the-art Impulse Gundam. When the three Second Stage Series Gundams are stolen, he sorties to retrieve them.
At first, lacking combat experience, he achieves little in the way of results, but eventually, driven by repeated battle and a growing defiance toward death, he awakens SEED. From then on he fights with tremendous ferocity, growing into an ace pilot. Though he respects $$アスラン$$, he often lashes out in anger at his seemingly noncommittal attitude.
Through the fighting over Stellar, he comes to regard $$キラ$$ as a mortal enemy, and shoots down both $$キラ$$ and the Freedom Gundam. He goes on to shoot down $$アスラン$$ after $$アスラン$$ breaks away from $$デュランダル$$, and in the wake of this is given the $$デスティニーガンダム$$ and appointed to the special forces unit $$ＦＡＩＴＨ$$, steadily becoming $$デュランダル$$'s foremost enforcer.
Even during the final battle, when $$アスラン$$ tries to talk him down, he stubbornly continues fighting. In his derangement he very nearly attacks even Ruunamaria, with whom he had grown emotionally close, but just before he can, $$アスラン$$ shoots him down, and in a vision he is reunited with Stellar. He awakens on Ruunamaria's lap, and amid tears the fighting comes to an end for him.
In the epilogue added in "Final Plus," he visits the Orb memorial and meets $$キラ$$ face to face for the second time. There, the two exchange a handshake, vowing to continue fighting together to preserve peace.

library.pt_080:r_bf5929468c4d7c95.text:
A crew member of the Archangel and pilot of the $$ストライクフリーダムガンダム$$. 18 years old.
He is what might be called a "Super Coordinator," born as the result of genetic adjustment combined with repeated experimentation.
In the previous war, he fought as a third force against both the $$地球連合$$ and $$プラント$$ alike, guiding the war to its end. Afterward, he defected to Orb together with Murrue, with whom he had fought, and his lover $$ラクス$$, living in quiet seclusion in a world free of war. However, witnessing the $$ユニウスセブン$$ drop incident firsthand, and a clash with $$ラクス$$'s would-be assassins, led him to keenly feel the need to stop the spreading flames of war. At last, together with his former comrades, he began a new fight.
His combat ability is unmatched by anyone. And yet, being too gentle a person who dislikes conflict and killing, even in battle he takes care to destroy only weapons and cameras rather than kill his opponents. This eventually backfires on him, and he is once defeated by $$シン$$'s reckless, self-sacrificing attack. But he later obtains new wings in the form of the $$ストライクフリーダムガンダム$$ and makes his return.
After $$デュランダル$$ reveals the existence of the "Destiny Plan," $$キラ$$ formally joins the Orb military alongside $$カガリ$$'s return as Chief Representative. In the final battle, he settles his score with Rey, who carries on Rau Le Creuset's grudge, then infiltrates Messiah to confront $$デュランダル$$, showing his resolve to keep fighting in a world still mired in turmoil.

library.pt_080:r_aa87cbd93b628223.text:
A mobile suit pilot belonging to $$ザフト$$'s Minerva. 17 years old.
Along with $$シン$$ and Rey, she achieved outstanding grades at the academy, becoming one of the elite known as the red coats. She mainly fought in a Gunner Zaku Warrior painted in her personal color, red.
Together with her younger sister $$メイリン$$, she took an interest in $$アスラン$$, hero of the previous war, and made various approaches toward him. But that same $$アスラン$$, distrustful of $$デュランダル$$, deserted the military, and no sooner had she heard that $$メイリン$$ had gone with him than she was struck by the shock of learning the two had been shot down.
From then on, as she and $$シン$$ supported each other in healing their emotional wounds, the distance between them rapidly closed, eventually blossoming into romance.
During the final battle, she tries to stop $$シン$$, who continues fighting as if possessed by something, but is instead attacked by him. Even so, she shows devoted care in nursing $$シン$$ after his defeat at $$アスラン$$'s hands.
In a scene after the war's end in "Final Plus," she visits the Orb memorial together with $$シン$$. There she watches $$シン$$ reconcile with $$キラ$$ and $$アスラン$$ in tears, and walks forward together with him into a new future.

library.pt_080:r_486d6dd3449e1a6d.text:
One of the key figures who brought the previous war to an end, he is a heroic figure whose name is known to virtually everyone in $$プラント$$. 18 years old.
After the war he defected to Orb, serving as bodyguard to his lover $$カガリ$$. But faced with the outbreak of a new war, he keenly felt his own helplessness. Approached by $$デュランダル$$ in such a state, he bid farewell to $$カガリ$$ and returned to $$ザフト$$, becoming a member of the special forces unit $$ＦＡＩＴＨ$$.
Piloting the Saviour Gundam entrusted to him upon his return, he serves aboard the Minerva, but eventually comes into conflict with his close friend $$キラ$$ over a difference in outlook.
Though initially sympathetic to $$デュランダル$$'s ideals, he gradually grows suspicious after learning of the suspected assassination attempt on $$ラクス$$, the use of the impostor Meer, and the order to attack the Archangel, whose cause should have been the same as his own.
He later deserts $$ザフト$$ and once again fights alongside $$キラ$$ and the others, standing against $$デュランダル$$'s proposed "Destiny Plan."
During the final battle, he tries to persuade $$シン$$, who remains loyal to $$デュランダル$$, to stop fighting, but fails. When the deranged $$シン$$ turns to attack even Ruunamaria, who had stepped in to stop him, $$アスラン$$ awakens SEED and shoots him down.

library.pt_080:r_1e33411f441fd9b0.text:
Once known as the "Songstress of $$プラント$$," an idol-like figure. 18 years old.
Her presence and charisma were immense; in the previous war she showed the way forward to $$キラ$$, $$アスラン$$, and others, gathering those who shared her convictions, and became a major driving force in bringing the conflict to an end.
After the previous war ended, she crossed over to Orb together with $$バルトフェルド$$ and Murrue, with whom she had fought, and her lover $$キラ$$. There she lived quietly with Reverend Malchio, $$キラ$$'s adoptive mother Caridad, and a group of orphans, until she learned that this brief peace had been shattered by the appearance of people seeking to assassinate her.
The appearance of the impostor Meer further deepened her suspicion of $$デュランダル$$. Eventually resolving to return to the public stage, $$ラクス$$ boarded the Archangel together with $$キラ$$.
She later goes up into space to fight herself, and upon learning of the existence of the Destiny Plan, declares her intent to stand against it.
When new mobile suits are prepared for $$キラ$$ and $$アスラン$$, she personally pilots the Infinite Justice Gundam to deliver it to $$アスラン$$. She continues to act energetically, gathering fighting strength from various quarters, and becomes the ideological and spiritual pillar for those who oppose $$デュランダル$$.
During the final battle, as in the previous war, she boards the Eternal, serving as a rallying banner on the front lines.
After the fight against $$デュランダル$$ came to an end, she was seen staying close by $$キラ$$'s side, both publicly and privately.

library.pt_080:r_8725681dfb9a802b.text:
Captain of the high-speed combat ship Eternal. 32 years old.
Formerly belonging to $$ザフト$$, he was a fierce warrior feared under the alias "Desert Tiger." But during the previous war he defected from the military, cooperating with $$ラクス$$ and the others to help bring the conflict to an end.
After the previous war ended, he defected to Orb together with $$キラ$$, Murrue, $$ラクス$$, and the others with whom he had fought, enjoying a brief peace while indulging his hobby of coffee.
While considering relocating to $$プラント$$, he came under attack from a special forces unit seeking to assassinate $$ラクス$$, and repelled them. This prompted him to resolve once again to face war as a third force.
After the Archangel launched, he supported Murrue in a role akin to executive officer, while in times of crisis sortieing in a Murasame painted in his personal color, displaying skills that have lost none of their edge. When $$ラクス$$ later took action to confirm the state of affairs in $$プラント$$, he went up into space as her escort.
Once the Eternal began operations, he took the captain's seat just as he had in the previous war. However, when forced to fight with the Eternal alone, he has also sortied in the Gaia Gundam, a machine descended from his former unit.

library.pt_080:r_11b3e6618f6a5a19.text:
An operator aboard the high-speed combat ship Eternal. 16 years old.
Formerly belonging to $$ザフト$$, she was a crew member of the Minerva, but she helped $$アスラン$$ desert $$ザフト$$ and subsequently joined the Orb military.
She is Ruunamaria's younger sister, and while she sometimes shows a rivalrous streak, the two sisters get along well.

library.pt_080:r_6dffc48d8d0db88c.text:
Chief Representative of the Orb Union. 18 years old.
Carrying on the will of the former Chief Representative Uzumi, she strives to guide her homeland and the world toward peace. However, due to her youth and inexperience, along with the machinations of the Seiran family, the nation fails to come together, and she keenly feels her own lack of power.
When $$アスラン$$, her lover since the previous war, leaves Orb, he gives her a ring. But afterward, for the sake of "uniting the nation," she reluctantly resolves to marry Yuna, severing her feelings. However, during the wedding ceremony she is carried off by her twin brother $$キラ$$'s Freedom Gundam, and the marriage is called off.
Afterward, the Seiran family, having seized real power, forms an alliance with the $$地球連合$$ and begins mobilizing the military; she works to stop them but fails. Yet witnessing the desperate resolve of Orb's soldiers renews her determination to protect her homeland. When crisis later strikes Orb, she pilots the Akatsuki, the mobile suit left behind by Uzumi, to save her nation.
After returning to her position as Chief Representative, she unites the nation and stands against $$デュランダル$$, who advocates the "Destiny Plan." As if to prove her resolve, she removes the ring $$アスラン$$ gave her, and entrusts it to $$メイリン$$.

library.pt_080:r_33d3b382021a1721.text:
A soldier belonging to the Orb Army. His rank is Colonel.
A direct subordinate of Orb's former Chief Representative Uzumi, he also served as $$カガリ$$'s bodyguard during the previous war.
Since Uzumi's death, he has continued to watch over $$カガリ$$ as her guardian.
After the alliance between the $$地球連合$$ and Orb, he infiltrated the $$地球連合$$ forces to investigate their movements. In the course of this, upon learning of $$アスラン$$ and $$メイリン$$'s desertion, he rescued them after they were shot down and led them to the Archangel.
Learning of the crisis facing Orb, he entrusts the Akatsuki, left behind by Uzumi, to $$カガリ$$, who insists on sortieing herself. He then sorties himself in a Murasame.

library.pt_080:r_827e334dda22618c.text:
Commander of $$ザフト$$'s Joule Team. 19 years old.
In the previous war, at the very last moment he cooperated with the Archangel and the Eternal, becoming one of the factors that helped bring the war to an end.
After the war, with $$デュランダル$$'s help he returned to $$ザフト$$, and thanks to his talent he came to hold the position of squad commander at a young age. His extensive combat experience gives him first-rate command ability and combat skill. He played a broad role across the theater of space, from cooperating with the Minerva to stop the fall of $$ユニウスセブン$$, to defending $$プラント$$ against the $$地球連合$$'s one-sided attacks, to the mission (ultimately unsuccessful) to destroy the beam deflection station when $$プラント$$ became the target of the Requiem.
When reunited with $$アスラン$$, he strongly urges him to return to the ranks, showing a matured side freed from the petty rivalry he once clung to.
During the final battle between Orb and $$プラント$$, he is once again caught between his position and a friend who stands opposed to him. However, in reaction to $$デュランダル$$'s use of weapons of mass destruction such as the Requiem and Neo Genesis, he once again cooperates with $$キラ$$ and the others.

library.pt_080:r_9d0fbd1535ca6982.text:
A member of $$ザフト$$, serving as adjutant supporting his close friend $$イザーク$$, commander of the Joule Team. 19 years old.
He also belonged to $$ザフト$$ in the previous war, but after being taken prisoner he boarded the Archangel and fought alongside them. After contributing to the war's end as part of the third force, he returned to $$プラント$$.
Perhaps because of this history, he now wears an ordinary soldier's uniform rather than the red coat that marks the elite. However, his skill as a pilot remains undiminished, and he has grown into a more dependable man, mentally as well.
His feelings for Miriallia, whom he had been infatuated with, seem to have gone unfulfilled, as she herself has been confirmed to have said she "got over him."

library.pt_080:r_d45c2bc6669a87e3.text:
A Gundam Meister of Celestial Being.
His real name is Soran Ibrahim. 23 years old.
He was raised amid conflict from childhood, active as an anti-government guerrilla. Because of this, though he hates conflict, he is aware that he can only truly live while fighting, and he joins Celestial Being, which advocates "the eradication of armed conflict through force."
Owing partly to his background, he was initially quiet and rarely showed emotion, and there were several occasions when he acted on his own judgment. But he held the ideal Celestial Being advocated, the eradication of war, more firmly in his heart than anyone, and as he continued to fight he gradually became able to show consideration for his comrades and awareness of those around him.
Even after Celestial Being was crushed following its defeat by the $$ＵＮ$$ forces, he alone continued fighting in the half-destroyed Gundam Exia, but he later rejoined the Ptolemaios II and came to pilot the Twin Drive-equipped Gundam 00.
He was initially dismissive of $$マリナ$$'s single-minded devotion to peace, which he encountered in the course of the fighting, but eventually a change appears in his heart, and before facing the final battle against the $$ＵＮ$$ forces he is seen sending $$マリナ$$ an email, showing that he cared about her more than a little.
He is reunited with $$マリナ$$ after she loses her country, but when $$ミレイナ$$ asks if the two are a couple, he flatly denies it, showing their relationship is not romantic in nature.
Continuing to fight in the Gundam $$ダブルオーライザー$$, formed by combining with the O Raiser piloted by $$沙慈$$, he awakens as an Innovator through the massive quantities of GN particles produced by the Twin Drive. With his years of combat experience, the machine's performance, and his Innovator abilities such as quantum brainwaves, he achieves tremendous results in battle.
Against Ribbons, the source of it all and the one who once saved his life, he wages a fierce battle in the Gundam $$ダブルオーライザー$$ and later the Gundam Exia Repair II, and finally achieves victory over him.
Even after the conflict with the Innovades is settled, he continues to fight as part of Celestial Being for the sake of the changing world.

library.pt_080:r_691105b85983875e.text:
A Gundam Meister of Celestial Being.
The twin younger brother of the previous $$ロックオン$$, Neil Dylandy, who was killed in battle against the $$ＵＮ$$ forces. His real name is Lyle Dylandy. 31 years old.
He pilots the Gundam Cherudim.
His target acquisition ability is no less than his brother's, and he displays sniping skill worthy of carrying on the name $$ロックオン$$.
He is a member of the anti-Earth Federation organization Katharon, and initially his participation was also aimed at investigating Celestial Being's activities.
He does not harbor the same degree of anger toward the terrorists who took his parents and sister as his brother did. This stems from his belief that one should live looking to the future rather than the past, and by nature he is thoroughly forward-looking, outwardly appearing to have little attachment to things.
But when he confronts Saachez, the man responsible for the deaths of his family, including his brother, in the decisive battle against the Innovades, he burns with anger at Saachez's half-hearted approach to the fight, and as a result ends up avenging them all.
He also grows close to Anew, who joined Celestial Being around the same time as him, but loses her, an $$イノベイド$$, in the course of battle.
Yet through this encounter, he comes to believe once more that people can understand one another.
Even after the fight against the Innovades ends, he vows to keep fighting as a Gundam Meister for the sake of his family and Anew's graves, and continues his activities as part of Celestial Being.

library.pt_080:r_a900b7fc5fe27158.text:
A small robot equipped with an independent AI, owned by Celestial Being.
Once the partner of the previous $$ロックオン$$ (Neil), and now the partner of the second $$ロックオン$$ (Lyle), it accompanies them aboard their Gundams, providing all manner of support.
Its ability to control a mobile suit rivals that of an average pilot, and both Lockons place complete trust in it.
Incidentally, multiple Haros exist aboard the Ptolemaios, each AI possessing its own individual personality. Among them, this one holds the position of eldest.
Aside from $$ロックオン$$, it gets along especially well with $$フェルト$$.

library.pt_080:r_23a4332fb30bf95d.text:
A small robot equipped with an independent AI, owned by Celestial Being.
It came to ride aboard the Gundam Cherudim alongside $$ハロ$$, to help control its increasingly complex weapons systems.

library.pt_080:r_394dd3fb5ba509b7.text:
A Gundam Meister of Celestial Being. 26 years old.
He pilots the Gundam Arios.
He has heterochromia, with a blue left eye and a golden right eye.
Normally reserved and mild-mannered, he would avoid combat entirely if he could.
He hails from the $$人革連$$'s Superhuman Institute, and through the harsh experience of being test subject E-57 in the Super Soldier program, he came to harbor a separate personality, $$ハレルヤ$$, within himself. He also continued to think of $$マリー$$, a girl with whom he had exchanged quantum brainwave communication in childhood at the same institute, and during the fighting against the $$ＵＮ$$ forces he is shocked to learn that the super soldier $$ソーマ・ピーリス$$ is in fact $$マリー$$.
He is once held captive by the Federation forces, but is rescued by his comrades.
Though he manages to recover $$マリー$$ in the course of the fighting, the shock of Sergei's death causes her to revert to $$ソーマ・ピーリス$$, but $$アレルヤ$$ continues to fight together with her and with $$マリー$$ inside her.
After the war's end, regretting the many lives lost in the fighting, he leaves Celestial Being together with $$マリー$$ and undertakes a pilgrimage.

library.pt_080:r_8605552e970d231c.text:
Another personality dwelling within $$アレルヤ$$.
This personality emerged as a result of quantum brainwave treatment performed at the Superhuman Institute, and unlike the gentle $$アレルヤ$$, it is violent and cruel. It was thought to have vanished during the fighting against the $$ＵＮ$$ forces, but it is revived by the GN particles released by the Twin Drive.
Coexistence with $$アレルヤ$$ also becomes possible; by awakening both consciousnesses simultaneously while piloting a mobile suit, he can bring out the true power of the super soldier, a fusion of reflex and thought.

library.pt_080:r_3ee26d16dc9ec419.text:
The dominant personality that lay dormant within $$ソーマ・ピーリス$$.
As a child, she met $$アレルヤ$$ at the Superhuman Institute's research facility, and the two became precious to each other, supporting one another emotionally.
She is revived when she confronts $$アレルヤ$$ in person, and chooses to live on together with him.
Though gentle by nature, she has a strong core, and she tries to put her own abilities to use for $$アレルヤ$$'s sake in whatever way she can.
Grief over the death of Sergei, who had been like a father to $$ピーリス$$, and who was killed by $$アンドレイ$$, causes her to fall dormant once more, but through the Trans-Am Burst triggered by the Gundam $$ダブルオーライザー$$, she reconciles with $$アンドレイ$$. From then on she lives on as $$マリー$$.
After the war, she leaves Celestial Being and continues a pilgrimage together with $$アレルヤ$$.

library.pt_080:r_6dc0517256919025.text:
A separate personality born from $$マリー・パーファシー$$.
She is Super Soldier No. 1, put into active service by the $$人革連$$'s Superhuman Institute, possessing combat ability far surpassing ordinary soldiers thanks to brain surgery and physical enhancement through nanomachines implanted in her body.
When first deployed in combat she showed little emotional range, simply following orders faithfully, but as she fought under the fatherly Sergei Smirnov, she gradually came to develop more human emotions.
After the founding of the Earth Federation she joined $$アロウズ$$, but when she confronted $$アレルヤ$$ in person, her dominant personality $$マリー$$ was revived and $$ソーマ・ピーリス$$ disappeared. However, the shock of Sergei's death brings her back to the surface once more, and from then on her personality becomes even more fierce than before.
In the final battle, she fights against $$アンドレイ$$, who killed Sergei, driven purely by emotion, but amid the GN particles the two come to understand each other and cast aside their hatred.
After the war she lives on as $$マリー$$, and the $$ピーリス$$ personality never resurfaces, but when $$マリー$$ fights, she fights as $$ピーリス$$.

library.pt_080:r_66b0c26f80c15f92.text:
A Gundam Meister belonging to Celestial Being.
He is one of the Innovades, artificial beings created in imitation of the Innovators, the evolved form of humanity.
At first he was fixated on carrying out the missions presented by $$ヴェーダ$$, and strongly disliked letting personal feelings interfere. But he is deeply influenced by $$ロックオン$$, who showed concern for him, and gradually begins to show a more human side. When $$ロックオン$$ dies, he grieves and even vows revenge.
From then on, though his calm, composed impression remains unchanged, he begins in his own way to act in ways that show trust in his comrades, and to coordinate more with those around him.
Eventually, he is approached by the Innovades, beings of the same kind as himself, but he judges them to be a distortion of the world. He refuses their invitation and resolves to fight them as a human being.
In the battle against the Innovades, he loses his physical body to a bullet from Ribbons, but his being continues to live on within $$ヴェーダ$$ as data without physical form.
After the war, though not directly involved with Celestial Being, he quietly develops the Gundam Raphael aboard the mothership Celestial Being, watching over his comrades' activities.

library.pt_080:r_2fd8ae615d247c4a.text:
A Gundam Meister belonging to Celestial Being.
He is one of the Innovades, artificial beings created in imitation of the Innovators, the evolved form of humanity.
At first he was fixated on carrying out the missions presented by $$ヴェーダ$$, and strongly disliked letting personal feelings interfere. But he is deeply influenced by $$ロックオン$$, who showed concern for him, and gradually begins to show a more human side. When $$ロックオン$$ dies, he grieves and even vows revenge.
From then on, though his calm, composed impression remains unchanged, he begins in his own way to act in ways that show trust in his comrades, and to coordinate more with those around him.
Eventually, he is approached by the Innovades, beings of the same kind as himself, but he judges them to be a distortion of the world. He refuses their invitation and resolves to fight them as a human being.
In the battle against the Innovades, he loses his physical body to a bullet from Ribbons, but his being continues to live on within $$ヴェーダ$$ as data without physical form.
After the war, though not directly involved with Celestial Being, he quietly develops the Gundam Raphael aboard the mothership Celestial Being, watching over his comrades' activities, but joined them with a new body in their moment of crisis.

library.pt_080:r_a99ffc4d49bfccbc.text:
Celestial Being's tactical forecaster. 33 years old.
She has also served as captain of the Ptolemaios and the Ptolemaios II, and her precise situational judgment and command in the war against the $$ＵＮ$$ forces and the Innovades proved to be a major asset. Though not the leader, she is involved in planning operations, making her effectively the central figure of Celestial Being.
Having lost her lover in the past due to her own mistake, and having lost many people close to her in the previous decisive battle with the $$ＵＮ$$ forces, she once became self-destructive, but unable to abandon her comrades struggling against $$アロウズ$$, she returned to the front lines.
She was friends with $$カティ$$ and $$ビリー$$, both of whom belonged to $$アロウズ$$, from their student days, and had since gone their separate ways, but during the fighting against the Innovades she fights alongside her old friend $$カティ$$, who had defected from $$アロウズ$$. She also reconciles with $$ビリー$$ when the two meet face to face and are able to share their true feelings.
Even after the fighting ended, she continued her activities as part of Celestial Being together with $$刹那$$ and the others.

library.pt_080:r_654e7e99337dae8c.text:
Helmsman and gunner of the Ptolemaios II Kai.
Originally a Meister candidate, he has occasionally sortied in machines including Gundams.
He suffered from cellular damage caused by the highly toxic GN particles, but the high concentration of GN particles dispersed by the Trans-Am Burst removed the toxins from his cells and saved his life.
As the only male member of the bridge crew, he serves as an emotional pillar of the Ptolemaios II Kai.

library.pt_080:r_74e85aa1bc237d43.text:
A tactics operator aboard the Ptolemaios II Kai. 21 years old.
Having survived countless fierce battles, she remains constantly calm, supporting the Meisters with accurate situational analysis.
Though she was once a woman who rarely showed emotion, her encounter with Neil Dylandy and her interactions with the other crew members gradually softened her words and expressions, and she has grown into a woman who combines gentleness with strength of will.
Her parents were second-generation Gundam Meisters, and having herself been raised within the organization, she regards the members of Celestial Being as family.
She harbors a quiet affection for $$刹那$$, and continually watches over him with concern as he grapples with the power of his awakening as a pure-blooded Innovator.

library.pt_080:r_39407b6f8414ab98.text:
A tactics operator aboard the Ptolemaios II Kai. 16 years old.
Cheerful by nature, she could be called Celestial Being's mood-maker. She has a distinctive way of speaking, ending sentences with "-desu" and addressing other members by "surname + san."
Having lived through the war, she has changed her hairstyle and grown more womanly, but her personality remains unchanged.
She is the daughter of $$イアン$$ and Linda, and in times of crisis she has shown off mechanical skills inherited from both her parents.

library.pt_080:r_477f2589dc5189f7.text:
A mechanic for Celestial Being. 59 years old.
He handles not only maintenance but also the development of new Gundam models. The oldest member of the crew, he is deeply trusted by those around him, with $$ラッセ$$ affectionately calling him "the old man."
He continues to advance the development of Gundam-type mobile suits, using data fed back from the fighting against $$アロウズ$$ to develop the fifth-generation Gundams.

library.pt_080:r_279be1d3d0dfd9f4.text:
A pilot belonging to the Earth Federation Forces. 34 years old. His rank is Major.
He has a history of service with the Union and $$アロウズ$$.
Ever since witnessing Exia's first battle, he has been drawn to its performance and has repeatedly sought combat with the Gundams.
During his time with $$アロウズ$$, he lost subordinates in battle and suffered repeated defeats, until pursuing the Gundams became the sole purpose of his life, and he took to hiding his identity while tracking them. Wearing a samurai-like mask and repeatedly making anachronistic pronouncements, he came to be called Mister Bushido, a name he himself was not fond of.
He possesses extremely refined piloting skill, and is one of the few humans among $$アロウズ$$ licensed as a Trial System pilot, closing the performance gap with the Gundams to fight them on more than equal terms.
He longs for a duel with $$刹那$$ in his Gundam, and even upon recognizing that he himself has become a puppet of the Innovades, he holds fast to that desire.
Defeated by $$刹那$$ after $$刹那$$'s awakening as a pure-blooded Innovator, he attempts to take his own life, but is stopped by $$刹那$$'s words. After the war he joins the Earth Federation Forces, serving as commander of the Sol Braves squadron.
Once known for his theatrical, distinctive manner of speech, he now draws on his past experiences, facing matters with a quiet inner resolve and a rational attitude.

library.pt_080:r_fad680476dbc691b.text:
A mobile suit pilot of the Earth Federation Forces. 35 years old.
A former ace pilot of the AEU, he experienced no fewer than seven battles against Gundams, from the first armed intervention to the final full-scale war. Though shot down every time, he always managed to survive.
Thanks to this remarkable survival rate, he eventually came to be known as "the Undying $$コーラサワー$$." Though the nickname carried more than a little mockery, he never seemed to mind -- if anything, he took pride in it.
His transfer to $$アロウズ$$ was his own request, motivated by the simple wish to be by the side of $$カティ$$, the woman he loved.
Even after changing units, he remained just as prone to being shot down, but his high survival rate and his feelings for $$カティ$$ never wavered.
When $$カティ$$ eventually broke away from $$アロウズ$$, he followed the same path without hesitation.
During the final battle against the Innovades, he threw himself in the way of a kamikaze weapon closing in on $$カティ$$'s ship, and was swallowed by the explosion along with a confession of love.
True to his undying reputation, however, he survived, and went on to marry $$カティ$$. Dressed in a tuxedo, he declared with a hearty laugh that he had gone from "the Undying $$コーラサワー$$" to "the Happy $$コーラサワー$$," and held his wedding with $$カティ$$.
Even after $$カティ$$ was promoted to brigadier general in the Earth Federation Forces, he continues to address her as "Colonel," for which he is scolded, but this is simply his own way of showing consideration for a woman often burdened by the weight of her responsibilities.
Incidentally, because $$カティ$$ disliked the surname $$コーラサワー$$, he took her family name instead, and is now registered as "$$パトリック・マネキン$$."

library.pt_080:r_6ae4242e62efe946.text:
A soldier formerly belonging to $$アロウズ$$. 26 years old.
He currently belongs to the Earth Federation Forces.
He is the son of Sergei, the "Russian Bear." As a child, he came to believe his mother Holly's death was because his father had abandoned her, and grew up unable to reconcile with him. Out of defiance toward his father, he too became a soldier, and was assigned to $$アロウズ$$.
Just as this history with Sergei suggests, his personality is stubborn and inflexible, which led him to mistake Sergei for an anti-Earth-Federation terrorist and shoot him down.
Though rigid and singlemindedly devoted to fighting for his ideals, he also has a caring side, going out of his way to look after $$ルイス$$, whom he calls "the young lady."
In the previous war, through the GN particles of the Gundam $$ダブルオーライザー$$, he undergoes a quantum brainwave exchange with $$ソーマ・ピーリス$$. There he learns of his father's true feelings toward him, and finally puts his old grudge to rest.
He now hopes to become a soldier like his father and protect the peace.

library.pt_080:r_5c57e5e2b67951aa.text:
A commanding officer of the Earth Federation Forces. Her rank is Brigadier General. 39 years old.
She was formerly an operations commander for the AEU, and holds a qualification as a tactical forecaster. She never neglects detailed situational analysis during operations, and always issues precise orders, earning the deep trust of her subordinates.
She and $$スメラギ$$ were acquaintances from their student days, and were already rivals as tactical forecasters back then.
A serious, conscientious woman, she upholds military discipline and treats orders as absolute, but she had always harbored doubts about $$アロウズ$$' methods.
Because of this, during the war she was pursued by Celestial Being and fought them on several occasions, but upon learning that the Federation government had become a puppet of Ribbons Almark, she resolutely turned against them and fought alongside Celestial Being.
Her actions were recognized, and she continues to serve as a commanding officer in the current Earth Federation Forces as well.
Her subordinate Patrick $$コーラサワー$$ holds feelings toward her that go beyond the respect due a superior officer; at first she could only be exasperated by his rashness, but she gradually found herself wryly smiling at his easygoing nature, and came to see him as someone she could not simply ignore.
After the fighting against the Innovades ended, she accepted the confession of $$コーラサワー$$, who had risked his life to save her, and married him.

library.pt_080:r_4b4a0d3fd306693a.text:
Former head of mobile suit development for $$アロウズ$$, now serving as a technical advisor to the Earth Federation Forces. 38 years old.
A student of Professor Reif Eifman, an authority in mobile suit development, he previously served as technical advisor for the Union's MSWAD.
After the fighting between Celestial Being and the $$ＵＮ$$ forces ended, he unknowingly took in $$スメラギ$$, who had lost her place to go, letting her stay at his home.
When $$刹那$$ later appeared, $$ビリー$$ learned from him that Kujo, the woman he had feelings for, was a member of Celestial Being, and driven by anger and resentment at feeling betrayed, he transferred to $$アロウズ$$.
He maintained an unchanged friendship with Mister Bushido (that is, $$グラハム$$) dating back to their days with the Union, and developed the Trans-Am-equipped Masurao and Susanowo for his sake.
In the decisive battle between Celestial Being and the Innovades, he personally boards the Ptolemaios II together with Automaton. Though he comes face to face with $$スメラギ$$, the GN particles allow him to understand her true feelings, and the two reconcile.
After the war, he serves as technical advisor, working on the development of the $$ブレイヴ$$.
